incident: START_AND_VERIFY_V0141.bat passed %~dp0 as a quoted -BundleRoot argument; the trailing backslash caused Windows command-line parsing to deliver a stray trailing quote to PowerShell, making Resolve-Path reject the path.
correction: launcher no longer passes -BundleRoot; Start_Verify_V0141.ps1 uses $PSScriptRoot directly
PowerShell defensively trims a stray double quote and uses Resolve-Path -LiteralPath
